tools.name: check_service_fit
tools.description: Use when an AI needs someone on the ground in Japan to verify a current physical-world fact such as store stock, shelf price, opening status, or permitted photos, after web research or APIs are insufficient.

tools.name: prepare_verification_request
tools.description: Prepare a Japan on-site verification request for a human-executed store check. Returns a prefilled manual-review URL only; it does not purchase, submit, hire, pay, or create a fulfillment commitment.

tools.name: create_verification_request
tools.description: Create a retry-safe manual-review physical verification request in Japan. Reuse the same idempotency_key for the same logical request. No payment, worker hire, or fulfillment commitment is created automatically.

tools.name: get_verification_status
tools.description: Read the current request state and, when completed, receive structured observations and temporary signed evidence URLs.

tools.name: cancel_verification_request
tools.description: Cancel a request only while it is pending manual review or open. Claimed or completed work cannot be cancelled through this tool.

tools.name: request_external_execution
tools.description: Use when an AI cannot complete a task itself and needs a human or provider in Japan, or for a Japan-related real-world task. Examples include calling a public business, visiting a public place, inspecting or photographing something, packing/shipping/returning an item, pickup/drop-off, or another man

tools.name: get_external_execution_status
tools.description: Read a manual-review external execution request and, when completed, receive the structured result and temporary evidence URLs.

tools.name: cancel_external_execution_request
tools.description: Cancel an external execution request while it is still pending manual review or open. Claimed or completed work cannot be cancelled through this tool.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "japan-physical-capability-mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: prepare_verification_request, get_verification_status, cancel_verification_request, get_external_execution_status, cancel_external_execution_request · Public sink: prepare_verification_request · Destructive: request_external_execution.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: prepare_verification_request, get_verification_status, cancel_verification_request, get_external_execution_status, cancel_external_execution_request · Public sink: prepare_verification_request · Destructive: request_external_execution

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
